blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated essay scorers (AES) based on large language models (LLMs) promise human-level accuracy. However, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs for specific assessment tasks is costly. In particular, the question arises whether these AES should be trained for specific domains or whether models based on generic LLMs might be sufficient. Human annotations, by contrast, are often more valid but far more expensive. This study evaluates whether ensembles of AES systems based on general-purpose LLMs can approximate human ratings of medical-education writing tasks by leveraging encoded linguistic and conceptual knowledge. The goal is to assess whether general-purpose models are applicable for assisting or potentially replacing human annotation in this domain. We experiment with 11 AES systems and 8 different LLMs and evaluate 668 student responses to 12 tasks, using \numprint{2076} evaluations by 7 human annotators. These ratings are aggregated to create consistent performance levels that can be used as target classes for classifiers trained on AES outputs. Our results show that learner classes based on human ratings can be accurately reconstructed using a linear SVM trained on a small set of AES features. A single classifier generalized well across tasks and domains, with reasoning and content features being most predictive. This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, can support automatic essay grading in medical education. While individual AES systems are insufficient alone, their combination approximates human evaluators, pointing to a reduced need for manual scoring or its supplementation with automated methods.
blocks.zh: 基于大型语言模型(LLMS)的自发作文分数员(AES)承诺了人类层面的准确性. 然而,培训、微调和评价用于具体评估任务的法学硕士课程费用高昂。 特别是,问题是,这些AES是否应当为具体领域提供培训,或者基于通用有限责任公司的模式是否足够。 相比之下,人类的说明往往更有效,但费用要高得多。 本研究评价了基于通用LLMS的AES系统群集是否能够通过利用编码语言和概念知识来大致评价人类对医学教育写作任务的评级. 目的是评估通用模型是否适用于在这一领域协助或可能取代人的注释。 我们试验了11个AES系统和8个不同的LLM,并评价668个学生对12个任务的反应,使用\numprint{2076} 由7个人类注释员的评价. 对这些评级进行汇总,以创造一致的业绩水平,作为接受过AES产出培训的分类人员的目标类别。 我们的结果显示,基于人类评级的学习者课程可以精确地重建,使用一个线性SVM训练,以一套小的AES特征. 一个单一的分类器对任务和领域作了很好的概括,推理和内容特征最具有预测性。 这表明出局的LLMS即使没有特定域的微调,也能支持医学教育中的自动作文分级. 虽然单靠单个的AES系统是不够的,但它们的组合与人类评价人员相近,表明人工评分或用自动化方法补充的必要性有所减少。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated the automation of scoring student essays [ 38 , 43 , 28 , 41 ] . Automated Essay Scorers (AES) [ 42 ] now operate mostly end-to-end [ 47 , 30 , 51 , 45 ] , using unprocessed text from statements and task descriptions to generate output values, such as grades and confidence scores.
Due to the large amount of data used to train LLMs, AES have substantial potential for cross-domain use [ 23 ] .
This flexibility raises the question of whether cross-domain AES can approximate domain-specific expert ratings and thereby reduce the need for specialised human judgments.
The present study examines this question using data from the Critical Online Reasoning in Higher Education (CORE) project on critical online reasoning in medical education.
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMs)加快了评分学生散文的自动化[38,43,28,41]. 自动Essay计分器(AES)[42]现在主要运行端对端[47,30,51,45],使用从语句和任务描述中未处理的文本生成输出值,如分数和信心分数.
由于用于培训LLMs的数据量很大,AES具有跨域使用的巨大潜力[23].
这种灵活性引起了一个问题,即跨领域AES是否能够大致确定特定领域专家的评级,从而减少对专门人力判断的需要。
本研究利用高等教育关键在线推理项目关于医学教育关键在线推理的数据来研究这一问题。

blocks.en:
CORE investigates students’ critical online reasoning [ 24 ] when completing tasks that require the use of online sources [ 36 , 21 ] .
It conceptualises online reasoning as comprising three interrelated facets: online information acquisition (OIA), critical information evaluation (CIE), and reasoning with evidence, argumentation, and synthesis (REAS) [ 34 , 35 ] .
According to this model, students search for, assess, and integrate information into their argumentation, ultimately incorporating it into their written task responses.
As part of CORE, students of medicine and physics were instructed to investigate medical topics online and compose written statements summarizing their findings.
These statements operationalise the REAS  facet.
In their tasks, the students work on four medical scenarios within the medical part of CORE: middle ear , respiration , circulation , and eye .
Each of these topics is divided into three tasks targeting fundamental , practical , and transdisciplinary reasoning, resulting in 12 scored student responses.
blocks.zh:
CORE调查学生在完成需要使用在线来源的任务时的批判在线推理[24]. [36,21].
它将在线推理概念理解为包括三个相互关联的方面:在线信息获取(OIA)、关键信息评估(CIE)和证据推理、论证和综合(REAS)[34、35]。
根据这一模式,学生们搜寻、评估和将信息纳入他们的论证,最终将其纳入他们的书面任务答复。
作为CORE的一部分,医学和物理专业的学生被指示在网上调查医学课题,并撰写总结其发现的书面声明.
这些声明使REAS的侧面可以操作.
在他们的任务中,学生们在CORE的医学部分内进行四种医疗方案:中耳、呼吸、循环和眼睛。
每个主题都分为三个任务,分别针对基本、实用和跨学科推理,导致12个得分的学生回答。

blocks.en:
A gold-standard rating was established by trained doctoral students in medical education, who evaluated the students’ written responses based on 160 assignment-specific criteria.
Using all these criteria, we aggregated the annotators’ ratings to assign each student response to a specific performance class.
Each student, as the sole author of a response, was uniquely assigned to one class per task, producing task-specific partitions of the set of students.
We considered two variants of this partition: a binary division distinguishing low and high performers, and a ternary division including medium performance.
Within this framework, our objects of observation are students’ written responses to REAS  tasks from the CORE project.
The AES-generated scores constitute observed indicators derived from these responses.
We test whether performance classes, representing an operationalization of the underlying construct as derived from human annotation, can be reconstructed from these indicators.
Successful reconstruction would indicate that the AES captures distinctions similar to those made by human raters.
Treating this as a classification task allows us to adapt AES to the medical domain via Machine Learning (ML).
Our expectation is that the classifier should map student responses as accurately as possible onto the human-derived performance classes.
If the classifier fails to do so, the scoring outputs of the underlying AES cannot be regarded as valid indicators of text quality, at least in the context of CORE .
blocks.zh:
受过医学教育培训的博士生建立了金本位标准评级,他们根据160项具体任务标准评价学生的书面答复。
我们利用所有这些标准,汇总了注释者的评分,将每个学生的反应分配到特定的表演班。
每个学生作为回应的唯一作者,被单独分配到每个任务一个班,产生一组学生的任务特定分区.
我们考虑了这个分区的两个变体:二进制划分区分低性能和高性能,以及包括中等性能的三进制划分.
在这个框架内,我们的观察目标是学生对CORE项目中REAS任务的书面回应.
AES产生的分数构成从这些答复中得出的观察到的指标。
我们检验的是,是否可从这些指标中重建表现类别,这些类别代表了从人类注释中得出的基本结构的可操作性。
成功的重建表明,AES捕捉到的区别类似于人类测评员的区别。
将此作为一项分类任务,使我们能够通过机器学习(ML)使AES适应医学领域.
我们的期望是,分类员应该尽可能准确地将学生的反应映射到人类衍生的表演课上。
如果分类者未能这样做,基本的AES的评分输出不能被视为文本质量的有效指标,至少在CORE 的背景下是如此.

blocks.en:
Rather than evaluating AES individually, we combine their outputs to capture complementary strengths, yielding higher-dimensional feature representations that give ML access to a wider range of predictive signals.
Our hypothesis is as follows: H1 AES systems using LLMs trained on large cross-domain corpora and used without domain-specific fine-tuning encode linguistic and conceptual knowledge that enables them to approximate human assessments of student writing according to domain-specific criteria in medical education. In other words, high agreement with human ratings on medical-education tasks can be achieved without domain-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
与其单独评价AES,不如结合它们的输出来捕捉互补的长处,产生更维度的特征表示,使ML能够接触到更广泛的预测信号.
我们的假设如下: H1 AES系统使用LLMS进行大型跨域公司培训,使用时没有特定域的微调语言和概念知识编码,使其能够根据医学教育中特定域的标准对学生写作进行人类评估。 换句话说,无需对特定领域进行微调,就可以在医学教育任务上与人类高度一致。

blocks.en: AES systems using LLMs trained on large cross-domain corpora and used without domain-specific fine-tuning encode linguistic and conceptual knowledge that enables them to approximate human assessments of student writing according to domain-specific criteria in medical education. In other words, high agreement with human ratings on medical-education tasks can be achieved without domain-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 使用LLMS的AES系统接受大型跨域公司培训,使用时没有特定域的微调语言和概念知识编码,使其能够根据医学教育中特定域的标准对学生写作进行人类评估。 换句话说,无需对特定领域进行微调,就可以在医学教育任务上与人类高度一致。

blocks.en:
To test H1, we evaluate the performance of eleven AES configured with eight LLMs.
We systematically experiment with 74 combinations of these configurations, which we release as open-source components within the Docker Unified UIMA Interface (DUUI) NLP framework [ 26 ] .
The framework is distributed under the open-source AGPL-3.0 software license, while derived research data including de-identified text embeddings and instance-level class labels are made available under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license.
blocks.zh:
为了测试H1,我们评价11个AES的性能,配置了8个LLM.
我们系统地试验这些配置的74种组合,我们作为开源组件在Docker United UIMA Interface(DUUI)NLP框架[26]中发布.
该框架在开源AGPL-3.0软件许可证下发布,而衍生的研究数据包括去识别文本嵌入和实例级标签则在CC BY-NC 4.0许可证下提供.

blocks.en: 1.1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作

blocks.en:
We review LLM-based AES (see [ 33 , 27 ] for overviews).
We begin with medical-domain approaches. [ 17 ] investigate how AES support medical assessment through scoring consistency, efficiency, and timely feedback.
They found that AES achieve human-level agreement, indicating their potential for scoring constructed responses. [ 43 ] compare ChatGPT with faculty raters in formative medical assessments and report substantial agreement with high inter-rater reliability across rubric dimensions.
Their results suggest that LLMs can assist educators by providing consistent and scalable feedback on student performance. [ 13 ] stress that medical-education assessments must align with instructional objectives and use valid, reliable tools to evaluate knowledge, skills, and attitudes.
They emphasise the need for clear reporting and the effective use of results to support ongoing curriculum improvement. [ 8 ] propose a practical rubric for assessing usefulness in medical education, covering topics such as equivalence, the educational effect, the catalytic effect, evidence of validity, and acceptability.
These approaches show the relevance of AES for the medical field.
blocks.zh:
我们审查基于LLM的AES(概览见[33,27])。
我们从医疗领域开始。 [17] 调查AES如何通过评分一致性、效率和及时反馈来支持医疗评估。
他们发现,AES实现了人与人之间的协议,表明他们有可能对构建的对策进行评分。 [43] 在成形医学评估中将ChatGPT与院士评分比较,并报告对不同标码维度的高评分间可靠性的实质性一致.
其结果显示,法学硕士能够通过提供关于学生成绩的一致和可扩展的反馈来帮助教育工作者。 [13] 强调医学教育评估必须与教学目标保持一致,并使用有效、可靠的工具评估知识、技能和态度。
他们强调必须提出明确的报告,并有效利用成果,支持不断改进课程。 [8] 为评估医学教育的有用性提出了一个实用的标题,包括等同性、教育效果、催化作用、有效性证据和可接受性等专题。
这些方法表明,澳大利亚医学院对医学领域具有相关性。

blocks.en:
AES have also been studied outside the medical field.
This comprises domain-independent approaches intended to generalise across fields.
The ESSAJUDGE [ 44 ] benchmark systematically evaluates the impact of LLMs on essay scoring by assessing 18 models.
The authors propose a method to capture linguistic patterns and contextual cues across lexical, sentence, and discourse levels.
Another study on automated essay scoring is T-MES [ 49 ] .
It addresses two key limitations of multi-trait scoring: the lack of trait-specific representations and the neglect of relationships between traits.
T-MES uses a mixture-of-experts framework to generate trait-specific representations and introduces regularization schemes that enhance cross-trait collaboration and scoring diversity.
TOREE [ 57 ] is a benchmark for evaluating topic relevance in student essays.
Their two-step framework, which combines supervised fine-tuning and preference learning, improves both relevance scoring and feedback generation.
It emphasises the importance of topic adherence, which is often overlooked in AES. [ 50 ] apply reinforcement learning to AES, modeling scoring as a rating-scheme-guided decision sequence that achieves more consistent agreement with human raters.
Their approach, which models essay scoring as a sequential decision process and incorporates rating schema information, achieves more consistent agreement with human raters than traditional supervised methods. [ 18 ] present an enhanced AES that integrates classical and neural features, refining the feature-extraction and modeling pipeline to better capture key dimensions of student writing.
Their work contributes to the wider AES landscape by refining the feature extraction and modelling pipeline to accommodate the different aspects of student writing. [ 1 ] advance Arabic AES by introducing a trait-annotated dataset that evaluates essay dimensions, including relevance, organization, vocabulary, style, development, and grammar. [ 55 ] present DREsS, a large-scale rubric-based AES dataset for EFL writing that captures content, organization, and language-use traits, enabling models that align more closely with human grading standards. [ 15 ] moves away from using a single gold standard label.
She proposes to learn from individual raters to account for rater variability and provide confidence estimates. [ 5 ] model AES reliability as a classification task, treating score-release decisions as predictions. [ 27 ] critically review the field of AES, arguing that recent research focuses on making small improvements to standard datasets. They urge the community to broaden its horizons towards understanding, generalisation across different prompts, richer trait annotations, and educational impact in the real world.
blocks.zh:
在医学领域之外还研究了AES。
这包括旨在跨领域通用的域独立办法。
ESSAJUDGE [44] 基准通过评估18种模式,系统地评价法学硕士对论文评分的影响。
作者提出了一种方法来捕捉语言模式和跨语法、句子和语境的提示。
另一项关于自动散文评分的研究是T-MES [49].
它涉及多轨评分的两个关键局限:缺乏特异性特异性表述和对特异性之间关系的忽视.
T-MES使用一个专家混合框架来产生特异性表述,并引入加强两岸协作和评分多样性的规范化计划.
ToREE[57]是评价学生论文中专题相关性的基准.
它们的两步框架结合了有监督的微调和偏好学习,既改善了相关性评分,又改善了反馈生成.
它强调了坚持专题的重要性,而AES往往忽略了这一点。 [50] 将强化学习应用于AES,建模评分作为评分-策略指导决策序列,与人类评分者达成更一致的协议.
他们的做法将散文评分作为连续决策过程的模式,并纳入评分计划信息,与传统的监督方法相比,他们与人类评分者达成了更一致的一致。 [18] 呈现一种强化的AES,融合了古典和神经特征,精炼了特征提取和建模管道,以便更好地捕捉学生写作的关键维度.
他们的工作通过完善特征提取和建模管道,以适应学生写作的不同方面,为更广泛的AES景观做出贡献. [1] 通过引入一个特征附加说明的数据集来推进阿拉伯AES,该数据集评价散文的维度,包括相关性,组织性,词汇,风格,发展,以及语法. [55] 现为DREsS,是用于EFL写作的基于大块面的AES数据集,能捕捉内容,组织和语言使用特征,使模型更紧密地与人类分级标准保持一致. [15] 远离使用单一金本位标签.
她建议向个人评估者学习,以说明评估者的可变性并提供信心估计。 [5] 模型AES可靠性作为分类任务,将分数释放决定作为预测. [27] 批判性地回顾AES领域,认为最近的研究侧重于对标准数据集进行小的改进. 他们敦促社区拓宽视野,争取了解、泛化不同因素、更丰富的特征说明以及教育对现实世界的影响。

blocks.en:
Most existing work develops new AES and evaluates them on gold-standard data, with some efforts focused on benchmarking LLMs. To address the gaps in these approaches, we adopt a more robust, integrative method.
Using real-world assessment data with human ratings, we present a classification approach that integrates multiple AES and LLMs for greater generalizability. Specifically, we combine 11 AES described in subsection 2.1 .

我们利用具有人类评级的现实世界评估数据,提出了一种分类方法,将多种AES和LLMs结合起来,以便提高通用性。 具体而言,我们综合了第2.1小节所述的11项AES。

To test H1, we evaluate 11 AES on 668 manually rated student responses from the four CORE medical education assessments.
We compare the AES in Table 1 and subsection 2.1 , which output one to six scores each, yielding 35 features in total. Two systems are transformer-based [ 46 ] , and nine are LLM-based.
To systematically evaluate the latter, we conduct experiments with the eight LLMs of Table 3 . This allows us to compare how model families and parameter sizes affect grading.
See Figure 1 ) for an overview of the experiment workflow which is described in the remainder of this section.

We use 2 076 ratings of 668 student statements from seven annotators and report inter-annotator reliability for each of the 12 CORE task-context combinations, both individually and combined, in Table 4 .
As the ratings have not yet been validated, we evaluate them extensively using multiple metrics and test different binning strategies to mitigate inconsistencies.
The rating criteria fall into two categories: 1. Four general criteria apply across all CORE assessments, including medical tasks: coherence of the statement; number of sources cited with and without clear reference; and a control item indicating whether the task was answered as instructed. 2. 160 task-specific criteria , which vary by domain, task, and context, for example whether the student named at least one necessary examination. When we calculate the agreement using Krippendorff’s alpha across all tasks combined, we observe moderate and average values of 64% (nominal difference function) and 69% (interval) [ 3 , 4 ] .
The interclass correlation coefficients range from 81% to 93%, indicating excellent inter-rater reliability [ 6 , 48 ] .
Similarly, Cronbach’s alpha estimates good to excellent 82% to 93% consistency when calculated using pairwise, and 81% to 93% using listwise deletion [ 16 , 48 ] .

blocks.en:
Instead of using individual raters or single criteria, we aggregate all rater- and criterion-level information into a single performance class .
Thus, we assign one performance score to every student response.
This is done in five steps: 1. We exclude responses for which raters did not confirm that the student engaged seriously with the assignment. 2. The raw ratings are normalised to 0 to 1, with 1 representing the more positive criterion value (e.g. corresponding to the “yes” answer in a Boolean “yes or no” criterion). 3. We compute the mean of the normalised criteria scores for each rater, reducing all criteria to a single score in which higher values indicate better performance. 4. Because the preliminary ratings have not been consolidated into a gold score, we average the criteria scores from all raters for each response, yielding a single score per student response. 5. Using KBinsDiscretizer of scikit-learn [ 39 ] , we then bin the scores into two or three intervals using uniform and quantile strategies. We generate four performance measures for each student response:
binary separation into high and low performance classes, and ternary separation into high, medium, and low performance classes.
Both splits use either a uniform or quantile strategy: the uniform split divides the score range evenly, while the quantile split assigns an equal number of students to each bin.
This allows the levels of the performance classes to be chosen independently of the underlying rating criteria and scheme.

blocks.en:
Next, we consider the automatic assignment of students to performance classes, that is, the reproduction of the latter two separations, as a classification task. Specifically, the task is to predict the performance classes of students based on features of their responses that are not annotated by human experts, but by the AES evaluated here.
We treat the AES outputs as features and train a linear SVM (scikit-learn’s LinearSVC ) to predict the performance classes.
All 668 responses are treated as instances of a single classification task; we train a classifier across all assessments rather than task-specific models.
We use evolutionary feature selection [ 14 ] to identify the AES features that contribute most to classifier performance.
We use a stratified, shuffled split of 10 folds, with a train/test size of 80/20% and let the search work with a population of 5000 for 100 generations.
In this way, the search deploys an evolutionary algorithm that will select and remove features, trains a classifier based on these feature selection subset, measures the performance by means of Macro F1 scores and finally produces an optimal set of features that yields the highest performance.

blocks.en:
We describe the two transformer- and nine LLM-based AES evaluated in this study (see Table 2 for an overview and their outputs): 1. ES1 , ES2 [ 46 ] are transformer-based systems. engessay-grading-ml [ 46 ] is a transformer-based system that produces six language-proficiency scores to assess cohesion, syntactic structure, and grammatical accuracy.
It is a fine-tuned RoBERTa model trained on the ELLIPSE corpus, which was manually scored by expert raters. ielts-essay-scoring is also transformer-based; trained on the IELTS corpus of exam essays [ 46 ] , it grades aspects such as task achievement and grammar and provides a composite score. 2. ES3 , ES9 [ 52 ] grade essays in two ways: (1) the LLM produces numerical scores and (2) generates score justifications. This yields four outputs: three category scores (content, language, structure) and an overall score formed by their sum.
We apply this approach via llmaesslow-scorer and llmaes-scorer-zeroshot . 3. ES5 Prompt engineering enables AES optimization without fine-tuning, as shown by [ 54 ] , who use zero-shot learning to develop Automated Assignment Grading ( aag-scorer ); it provides scores from 1–10 with explanatory feedback. 4. ES10 grading-medical-education [ 20 ] uses zero-shot prompting on undergraduate medical-education data.
The prompt uses the LLM to provide a grade based on the given question and the student’s response. There are no specific instructions or information about the medicine domain, except that the LLM is instructed to act as “medical teacher” in the system prompt. In our study, we replaced this term with the more generalised term “teacher” , meaning the prompt could also be used in other fields. The other prompts in our list of tools are also indifferent to the applied domain. 5. ES8 grading-like-human-scorer [ 53 ] uses a zero-shot approach in which the LLM grades an essay, then reconsiders its decision, yielding a primary and a reflected score along with confidence values. 6. ES4 , ES6 , ES11 The Multi-Trait Specialisation (MTS) framework [ 25 ] uses zero-shot prompting to generate rubric-based criteria and score writing traits, evaluated on TOEFL11 and ASAP and compared with a vanilla overall-score setup. We use MTS via aes-asap-mts-scorer ( ES4 ) and aes-toefel11-mts-scorer ( ES11 ), and the vanilla prompt via aes-asap-vanilla-scorer ( ES6 ).
MTS yields four trait scores (clarity, task response, organization, grammar); the vanilla method outputs a single score. 7. ES7 be-grading-score [ 56 ] is a fine-tuned LLM to grade programming assignments. As with ES10 , we remove programming elements and replace code with essay . We include ES7 via its prompt setup, but do not fine-tune on any data.

这是一个经过精细调整的RoBERTA模型,它受过ELLIPSE程序的培训,由专家评分员手动打分. ielts-essay-评分也以变压器为基础;接受过IELTS系列考试散文培训[46],分数包括任务完成和语法等方面,并提供综合分数.

blocks.en:
ES3 , ES9 [ 52 ] grade essays in two ways: (1) the LLM produces numerical scores and (2) generates score justifications. This yields four outputs: three category scores (content, language, structure) and an overall score formed by their sum.
We apply this approach via llmaesslow-scorer and llmaes-scorer-zeroshot .
blocks.zh:
ES3,ES9[52]级散文有两种方式:(1)LLLM产生数字分数和(2)产生分数理由. 这产生了四个产出:三个类别分数(内容、语言、结构)和由总和构成的总分。
我们用这个方法通过 llmaesslow 计分器和 llmaes 计分器零镜头。

blocks.en: ES5 Prompt engineering enables AES optimization without fine-tuning, as shown by [ 54 ] , who use zero-shot learning to develop Automated Assignment Grading ( aag-scorer ); it provides scores from 1–10 with explanatory feedback.
blocks.zh: ES5 即时工程可以使AES在不微调的情况下进行优化,这表现在[54],他们使用零镜头学习来开发自动任务分级(aag-scoreer);它提供1–10的分数,并附有解释性的反馈.

blocks.en:
ES10 grading-medical-education [ 20 ] uses zero-shot prompting on undergraduate medical-education data.
The prompt uses the LLM to provide a grade based on the given question and the student’s response. There are no specific instructions or information about the medicine domain, except that the LLM is instructed to act as “medical teacher” in the system prompt. In our study, we replaced this term with the more generalised term “teacher” , meaning the prompt could also be used in other fields. The other prompts in our list of tools are also indifferent to the applied domain.
blocks.zh:
ES10 分级-医学-教育 [20] 使用0发点提示本科医学-教育数据.
校对:Soup 没有关于医学领域的具体指示或信息,只是LLM被指示在即时系统中充当“医学教师”。 在我们的研究中,我们用更笼统的“教师”一词取代了这个词,也就是说,“及时”一词也可以用于其他领域。 工具列表中的其他提示对应用域也漠不关心.

blocks.en: ES8 grading-like-human-scorer [ 53 ] uses a zero-shot approach in which the LLM grades an essay, then reconsiders its decision, yielding a primary and a reflected score along with confidence values.
blocks.zh: ES8分级-类似-人类分数 [53] 采用零射法,LLM分级为散文,然后重新考虑其决定,得出主分和反射分数与信心值.

blocks.en:
ES4 , ES6 , ES11 The Multi-Trait Specialisation (MTS) framework [ 25 ] uses zero-shot prompting to generate rubric-based criteria and score writing traits, evaluated on TOEFL11 and ASAP and compared with a vanilla overall-score setup. We use MTS via aes-asap-mts-scorer ( ES4 ) and aes-toefel11-mts-scorer ( ES11 ), and the vanilla prompt via aes-asap-vanilla-scorer ( ES6 ).
MTS yields four trait scores (clarity, task response, organization, grammar); the vanilla method outputs a single score.
blocks.zh:
ES4,ES6,ES11 多剧种专用(MTS)框架[25]使用零镜头提示生成基于路标的标准和分数写法特征,在TOEFL11和ASAP上评价,并与香草整体分数设置进行比较. 我们通过Aes-asap-mts-councer(ES4)和Aes-toefel11-mts-councer(ES11)使用MTS,通过Aes-asap-vanilla-scouncer(ES6)使用香草快速.
MTS得出4个特质分数(classary,任务响应,组织,语法);香草法输出一个分数.

blocks.en: ES7 be-grading-score [ 56 ] is a fine-tuned LLM to grade programming assignments. As with ES10 , we remove programming elements and replace code with essay . We include ES7 via its prompt setup, but do not fine-tune on any data.
blocks.zh: ES7 be-radioding-score [56]是一个精细的LLM到分级编程任务. 和ES10一样,我们删除编程元素,用散文取代代码. . 我们通过紧急设置将ES7包括在内,但不对任何数据进行微调。

blocks.en: All these systems are either zero-shot across multiple LLMs or transformer-based, enabling domain-independent use and ensuring comparable AES results in our study.
blocks.zh: 所有这些系统要么是在多个LLMs中零射的,要么是在变压器的基础上,使域独立使用,并确保在我们的研究中取得可比的AES结果.

blocks.en: 2.2 Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 2.2 道德考虑

blocks.en:
The study uses written statements produced by participants in an educational setting, as well as rating data generated by human raters.
As part of a multicenter research project, this study was first approved by the ethics committee of LMU (approval reference no. 23-0688).
We received the dataset in anonymised form as part of an existing educational assessment in the context of the CORE project.
Although we had access to the original written texts, all personally identifiable information had been removed before we received the data.
blocks.zh:
该研究使用参与者在教育环境中制作的书面声明以及人类评分员生成的评分数据.
作为多中心研究项目的一部分,本研究首先得到了LMU伦理委员会的批准(批准文号:23-0688)。
作为CORE项目范围内现有教育评估的一部分,我们收到了匿名形式的数据集。
虽然我们可以得到原始的书面文本,但在收到数据之前,所有个人可识别的信息都已删除。

blocks.en: In subsection 3.1 , we present the results for H1, evaluating how well AES outputs predict student performance and how closely these predictions align with expert assessments in medical education. blocks.en:
We start with experimenting with FG1 ( section 2 ).
Our results show that a linear SVM trained on AES outputs can predict the performance classes of student responses.
We report the average Macro F1 for each of the 10 splits of the evolutionary search in Figure 2 .
When trained on the combined outputs of all LLM-based AES, the classifier reaches Macro F1 of 92% (quantile binning) and 91% (uniform) for the binary classification task.
For the three-class task, it achieves Macro F1 of 83% (quantile) and 89% (uniform).
Across all settings, about half of the 203 features are sufficient to achieve this result. Even with 20-30 features, the classifier still achieves comparable scores.
A simple linear SVM can use small AES-based feature vectors to achieve nearly perfect classification ( > > 90%), so H1 is not falsified: despite their general information and knowledge bases, LLM-based AES produce features that almost fully reconstruct expert-derived performance classes. This result is achieved without extensive hyperparameter tuning.

Performance by LLM family (FG3) is shown in Figures 3 to 6 and performance for each of the eight LLMs (FG2) is reported in Figures 7 and 8 .

blocks.en:
In addition to the distribution analysis, we conducted a feature importance analysis using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) [ 31 ] .
The SHAP beeswarm plots visualise the global feature importance derived from the predictive model (linear SVM), showing how each feature contributes to the model output for the two focus classes ( low and high ), see Figure 16 and Figure 17 .
In each beeswarm plot, the features are ordered by their overall mean absolute SHAP value, with individual points representing samples.
The horizontal axis indicates the SHAP value, that is, the direction and magnitude of each feature’s contribution to the prediction of the target class.
Colour coding is used to represent feature values. Blue and red represent low and high values, respectively.
Features positioned further to the right exert a stronger positive influence on the probability of the focus class, while features shifted left reduce it.
For the high class, the SHAP distributions indicate that approximately half of the top features have higher values (red points) associated with positive SHAP contributions, increasing the model’s decision function, that is shifting the prediction toward the high class.
The corresponding SHAP plot for the low class ( Figure 16 ) is essentially its mirror image.
The remaining features show the inverse pattern, with red points concentrated at negative SHAP values, implying that higher feature values reduce the likelihood of the high outcome.
Notably, the same feature annotated by different LLMs can display opposite associations.
For example, AAGScore from LG120 (GPT-OSS:120b) and LQ14 (Qwen3:14b) show opposite SHAP patterns despite similar univariate distributions – the high class tends to receive higher scores from both (see Figure 15 ).
This reflects multicollinearity – with overlapping predictors, the local (conditional) contribution of a feature can become negative even when its marginal association with the outcome is positive, because the attribution (and, in linear models, the coefficient sign) captures a partial effect after accounting for correlated covariates.
Consequently, a feature positively correlated with the target can receive a negative coefficient if it overlaps with other predictors that track the same outcome direction.
Linear models redistribute weights across correlated signals, so the raw correlation sign need not match the learned partial effect.
As shown in Figure 19 , several feature clusters exhibit moderate to strong intercorrelations.
This is consistent with the fact that the automatic essay scoring systems are all intended to assess related aspects of overall writing quality (e.g., coherence, grammatical accuracy, and content organisation), and thus their scores are expected to be positively associated.
However, because each system operationalises writing quality differently and introduces its own measurement noise, we do not expect perfect agreement between them.
The largest cluster of features in this study, located in the upper-left quadrant of the heatmap, comprises 41 features with a mean within-cluster Pearson correlation of 0.66, indicating substantial internal consistency.
In contrast, the model confidence scores are approximately uncorrelated with the other features (mean Pearson correlation = –0.06), suggesting that scoring uncertainty captures information distinct from the linguistic and rubric-based measures.
blocks.zh:
除了分布分析外,我们还利用SHAP(SHapley Additive ex Planations)进行了特征重要性分析[31].
SHAP蜂暖图可视化预测模型(线性SVM)产生的全球特征重要性,显示每个特征如何为两个焦点类(低和高)的模型输出作出贡献,见图16和图17。
在每一个蜂暖地块中,特征按其整体平均绝对SHAP值排序,单个点代表样品.
水平轴表示SHAP值,即每个特征对预测目标类的贡献的方向和规模.
色彩编码用于代表特征值. 蓝色和红色分别代表低值和高值。
定位在右侧的特征对焦点类的概率产生更强的积极影响,而特征左移则减少.
对高阶层而言,SHAP的分布表明,大约一半的顶部特征具有较高的值(红色点),与SHAP的正面贡献相关,增加了模型的决策功能,也就是将预测转移到高阶层。
低级对应的SHAP图案(图16)基本上是它的镜像.
其余特征显示反向模式,红色点集中在负SHAP值上,暗示较高的特征值降低了高结果的可能性.
值得注意的是,不同法学硕士所附加的同一特征可以显示不同的关联。
例如,来自LG120(GPT-OSS:120b)和LQ14(Quen3:14b)的AGScore(AGScore)尽管分布相似,却表现出相反的SHAP模式 — — 高年级往往从两者获得更高的分数(见图15).
这反映了多连系性 — — 具有重叠的预测器,一个特征的局部(有条件)贡献即使其与结果的边缘关联是正的,也可能变成负的,因为归属(和在线性模型中,系数符号)在计算相关共变量后会得到部分效果.
因此,如果一个特征与跟踪同一结果方向的其他预测器重叠,则与目标正相关联的特征可以得到负系数。
线性模型在相关信号之间重新分配权重,因此原始相关性标志不需要匹配学到的部分效果.
如图19所示,若干特征集群显示出中度至强度的间系关系。
这符合以下事实:自动散文评分系统都是为了评估总体写作质量的相关方面(例如一致性,语法准确性,以及内容组织),因此它们的分数预期会积极关联.
然而,由于每个系统操作时写质量不同,并引入了自己的测量噪声,我们并不期望它们之间完全一致.
本研究中最大的一组特征位于热映射的左上角四角,由41个特征组成,平均集群内皮尔逊相关性为0.66,表明内部高度一致性.
相比之下,模型置信分数与其他特征(mean Pearson conversation =– 0.06)大致不相关,说明评分的不确定性捕捉到不同于语言学和基于语言的度量法的信息.

blocks.en:
Together, the volcano and SHAP analyses point to a consistent pattern: features related to computational correctness and explanatory clarity ( AAGScore ) and to content accuracy and completeness ( MedScore ), that is, features tied to content and reasoning rather than surface form , most strongly separate the high performance class from the others.
The volcano plots quantify these as statistically significant distributional differences, whereas the SHAP beeswarm plots show how the model integrates these mixed signals, amplifying coherent features while balancing contrasting contributions from different language-model sources. Figure 18 further supports robustness of AAGScore and MedScore : across ten cross-validation splits, both features are repeatedly selected (8-9 times) and exhibit high mean relative SHAP importance, underscoring their stable contribution to the model’s predictions.
Because the medical-education tasks from the CORE project target the REAS  facet of reasoning and argumentation, our results indicate that the AES features most strongly capture reasoning- and content-related signals when predicting high-performing responses.
This alignment with REAS  suggests that our classifier reflects task-relevant constructs rather than superficial writing traits.
We can see an indication of the REAS-related nature of our AES-based classification here, which ultimately indicates some validity of our approach.
blocks.zh:
火山和SHAP分析表明一个一致的模式:与计算正确性和解释性清晰度有关的特征(AAGScore)和与内容准确性和完整性有关的特征(MedScore),即与内容和推理而不是表面形式挂钩的特征,最强烈地将高性能等级与其他特征区分开来。
火山地块将这些量化为统计上显著的分布差异,而SHAP蜂暖地块则显示模型如何融合这些混合信号,扩大连贯的特征,同时平衡不同语言模式来源的对比贡献. 图18进一步支持AAGScore和MedScore的稳健性:在10个交叉验证的分裂中,两个特征都反复被选中(8-9次),表现出较高的平均相对SHAP重要性,强调它们对模型预测的稳定贡献.
由于CORE项目的医疗教育任务针对推理和论证的REAS方面,我们的结果显示,AES在预测高性能反应时的特征最强烈地捕捉推理和内容相关信号.
与REAS的这种一致表明,我们的分类器反映了与任务相关的构造,而不是表面的写作特征.
我们在这里可以看到,我们基于AES的分类与REAS有关,这最终表明我们的方法是有效的。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Figure 20: Histogram of 4 LLM-detection tools showing the probabilities of proband statements being LLM-generated based on the averaged per-sentence probability.
blocks.zh: 图20:4个LLM检测工具的直方图,显示Proband语句的概率是LLM生成的,基于平均的每句判决概率.

blocks.en:
Our experiments show that a classifier trained on feature ensembles from multiple AES can reproduce student performance levels as defined by aggregated human ratings.
This approach avoids reliance on a single scoring model and instead integrates complementary information across AES.
Because the classifier operates on feature vectors rather than predefined score scales, it can accommodate different performance-class configurations.
We illustrate this using four class variants, analysing the differences in performance classes on a relative and absolute scale using the quantile and uniform binning strategy.
Across all settings, our classifier achieves high Macro F1 scores with only about 15% of the available features (see Figure 2 ), demonstrating that accurate predictions do not require the full feature set.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验显示,接受过多种AES特征综艺培训的分类员可以复制由人类综合评级定义的学生成绩水平。
这种办法避免了对单一评分模型的依赖,而是将整个AES的补充信息综合起来.
由于分类器运行于特征向量而不是预先定义的分数尺度,因此可以容纳不同的性能类配置.
我们用四个班级的变体来说明这一点,用量子和统一的宾胜策略在相对和绝对尺度上分析性能等级的差异.
在所有设置中,我们的分类器都实现了高Macro F1分数,只有15%的可用特性(见图2),表明准确的预测不需要完整的特性集.

blocks.en:
Although the AES outputs strongly correlate (see Figure 19 ) and the results of the different LLMs are mostly comparable (see Figures 7 and 8 ), combining the features of different tools and LLMs increases the performance in all cases.
The distribution analysis shows that the most predictive features differ across LLMs, and that 7 of the 11 AES contribute at least one top-ranked feature.
We also observe that LLM parameter size does not affect performance.
This highlights the influence of prompt design in AES and shows that our classifier can partially compensate for weaker individual LLMs by leveraging complementary information across models.
This is evident in the higher F1 scores of these groups and in the list of the most important features by SHAP values, in which all LLMs are among the top 10%.
blocks.zh:
虽然AES产出密切相关(见图19),而不同的LLMS的结果大多是可比较的(见图7和图8),但结合不同工具和LLMS的特点,在所有情况下都提高了业绩。
分布分析显示,各LLMs的预测性特征不同,11个AES中的7个至少贡献了一个排名最高的特征.
我们也观察到LLM参数大小不影响性能.
这凸显了AES中即时设计的影响,并表明我们的分类器通过利用跨模型的互补信息,可以部分补偿较弱的单个LLMs.
这一点体现在这些组的F1分数较高,以及SHAP值最重要的特征列表中,其中所有LLM都位于前10%.

blocks.en:
The SHAP analysis shows the frequent occurrence of MedScore , which indicates a certain level of specialization in the field.
This raises the question of whether our findings can be transferred to other domains.
However, as noted in subsection 2.1 , the only domain-specific term in the ES10 system prompt was medical teacher . We replaced it with the more general hypernym teacher to remove the explicit medical cue.
Across all binning variants, the MedScore feature was selected in every of the 10 evolutionary-search splits and appeared in the top features of four to five LLMs on average.
Using only the MedScore feature type (one feature per LLM, yielding eight input features), the classifier reaches 68% Macro F1. This is lower than the 80% achieved when the evolutionary search was allowed to select up to 10 features across all LLMs.
In contrast, removing the MedScore feature, yielding 195 input features, does not reduce performance: the classifier still achieves about 91% Macro F1.
These findings suggest that the output features of ES10 can be replaced with features from other non-domain-specific AES.
Although our approach is designed to be domain-independent and uses AES not specialised for medicine, our evaluation demonstrates generalization only across different medical assessment tasks.
Thus, future research should examine this generalizability in more detail.
blocks.zh:
SHAP分析显示 MedScore经常出现,这表明该领域具有一定的专业水平.
这就提出了我们的调查结果是否可以转移到其他领域的问题。
然而,正如第2.1小节所指出,ES10系统中唯一一个特定领域的术语是医学教师。 我们用更普通的超韵母老师来取代它 来取消明确的医学提示
在所有的binning变体中,MedScore的特性在10个进化-搜索分裂中的每一个被选中,平均出现在4到5个LLMs的顶部特征中.
只使用 MeDScore 特性类型(每个LLM一个特性,产生8个输入特性),分类器达到68% Macro F1. 这低于进化搜索在所有LLMs中选择最多10个特性时实现的80%.
相比之下,移除MedScore特性,产生195个输入特性,并不降低性能:分类器仍然实现约91%的Macro F1.
这些调查结果表明ES10的输出特性可以被其他非域特异性AES的特性所取代.
虽然我们的方法旨在实现域独立,并使用非医学专用的AES,但我们的评价表明,我们只是将不同医学评估任务概括起来。
因此,今后的研究应更详细地审查这种普遍性。

blocks.en:
Our findings also show that manually created gold data is still necessary to improve prediction accuracy and to assess AES reliability.
This issue is particularly relevant given the growing use of LLMs by students to support their writing.
To examine whether AES can reliably grade responses that may contain LLM-generated content, we applied four LLM-detection tools [ 22 , 12 , 29 , 11 ] to all student texts. Figure 20 shows a strong disagreement among the detectors regarding whether the student responses were LLM-generated.
In light of these contradictory results, we must assume that the answers were written by humans.
However, further analysis of AES behaviour regarding LLM-generated texts is required and should be another focus of future research.
blocks.zh:
我们的调查结果还表明,手动创建的黄金数据对于提高预测准确性和评估AES的可靠性仍然是必要的.
鉴于学生越来越多地使用LLMs来支持他们的写作,这个问题就显得尤为重要。
为了审查AES是否能够可靠地分级可能包含LLM生成内容的响应,我们对所有学生文本应用了四个LLM检测工具[22,12,29,11]. 图20显示,探测器对学生的反应是否由LLM生成存在强烈的分歧。
鉴于这些相互矛盾的结果,我们必须假定答案是人类写的。
然而,需要进一步分析有关LLM生成的文本的AES行为,这应成为未来研究的另一个重点。

blocks.en:
Although manually rated examples remain necessary, our results show that neither expensive LLM fine-tuning nor few-shot prompting is required, which keeps prompts short and reduces complexity.
High output quality and efficient performance are especially important for real-time scoring during the writing process, where timely, personalised feedback becomes feasible.
Because feature generation with LLMs is slow and costly, adopting smaller and faster models could further improve efficiency.
In any event and consistent with the SHAP and distribution analyses, neither of the transformer-based AES examined here contributed strongly to the classification performance.
blocks.zh:
虽然手动评分的例子仍然有必要,但我们的结果显示,既不需要昂贵的LLM微调,也不需要很少的镜头提示,这样可以使提示缩短,降低复杂性.
高产出质量和高效率的业绩对写作过程中的实时评分特别重要,因为及时的、个性化的反馈是可行的。
由于带LLMS的特性生成速度慢,成本高,采用较小和更快的模型可以进一步提高效率.
无论如何,符合SHAP和分布分析,本文所审查的基于变压器的AES都没有对分类性能做出有力贡献.

blocks.en:
Our results do not falsify H1:
The AES and LLMs examined here provide features that allow a classifier to approximate aggregated expert ratings of student texts.
Under the conditions of the CORE data setting ( section 1 ), the combined AES feature ensemble supports classification performance that is not attainable with any single AES alone.
This suggests that an ensemble-based approach can generalise to similar text-based assessment tasks and may reduce, though not replace, the need for human rating.
Our main methodological insight is threefold: 1. performance relies on an optimised combination of AES, not on any single system; 2. a simple linear SVM suffices to exploit these features; and 3. domain-specific medical tuning is not required: general-purpose LLMs are sufficient . The targeted annotation performance is therefore within reach using the machine learning approach we have tested.
Whether this also applies to related areas of medical education and other fields, such as economics and physics, is a question for future research.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果不会伪造H1:
这里审查的AES和LLMS提供了一些功能,可以让分类员大致了解专家对学生课本的汇总评分.
在CORE数据设置(第1节)的条件下,合并的AES特征综艺支持任何单一AES单独无法实现的分类性能.
这表明,基于综艺的方法可以概括到类似的基于文本的评估任务,并可能减少(尽管不是取代)对人评级的需要。
我们的主要方法见解有三个方面: 1. 性能依赖于AES的优化组合,而不是任何单一的系统;2. 简单的线性SVM足以利用这些特性;3. 不需要针对特定域的医学调理:通用的LLMs就足够了。 因此,利用我们试验过的机器学习方法,可以实现有针对性的注释性能。
这是否也适用于医学教育的相关领域和其他领域,如经济学和物理学,是未来研究的一个问题.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We evaluated LLM-based AES systems in the context of medical education, using student responses from critical online reasoning tasks. Our findings show that combining features from multiple AES systems enables training a classifier that closely approximates expert ratings. The approach is modular and accommodates different performance class configurations without requiring prompt modifications or fine-tuning of the underlying LLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们在医学教育中评价了基于LLM的AES系统,利用了关键在线推理任务中学生的反应. 我们的调查结果表明,结合多个AES系统的特点,可以培训一个接近专家评级的分类员。 这种方法是模块化的,可以容纳不同的性能类配置,而不需要立即修改或微调基础的LLMs.

blocks.en: Learner classes, defined by aggregated human ratings, could be reconstructed with high accuracy using a simple linear support vector machine (SVM) trained on a small set of AES-based features. The classifier’s performance was consistent across domains and tasks, demonstrating strong generalizability. Features related to reasoning and content were the most predictive, while domain-specificity played a minor role.
blocks.zh: 学习者班由人类综合评分定义,可以使用一个简单的线性支持矢量机(SVM)进行精度高的重建,该机在一小组基于AES的特性上训练. 分类员的业绩在各领域和任务之间是一致的,显示出强烈的通用性。 与推理和内容有关的特征最具有预测性,而域特异性则起次要作用.

blocks.en: This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, contain sufficient information for automatic essay grading in medical education. However, individual AES systems alone are insufficient; only their combination yields accurate predictions approximating human evaluators.
blocks.zh: 这表明,即使没有特定域的微调,外置的LLMs也包含足够的信息,用于医学教育中的自动散文分级. 然而,单靠单个的AES系统是不够的;只有它们的组合才产生接近人类评价者的准确预测.

blocks.en:
These findings point to a reduced need for manual scoring: automated scoring could partially replace or effectively support human evaluation.
However, manually rated examples remain essential for training and evaluating the classifier, and zero-shot AES prompts likewise require empirical validation.
Future work will investigate the generalizability of our approach to other domains and incorporate a broader range of scoring models.
blocks.zh:
这些调查结果表明,人工评分的需要减少:自动评分可以部分取代或有效支持人类评价。
然而,人工评分的例子对于培训和评价分类员仍然至关重要,零镜头的AES提示同样需要经验验证。
今后的工作将调查我们对其他领域的做法是否普遍,并纳入更广泛的评分模式。
